target_near: Long original Monday low; short original Monday high.
target_far: Long original Monday high; short original Monday low.
cohort: Identical original near-eligible entries/stops at each N; does not include additional far-only eligible entries.
R: Signed price PnL divided by initial entry-to-stop risk; net subtracts per-fill fees. XAU net unknown.
realized_payoff_ratio: Mean profitable trade R / absolute mean losing trade R.
paired_stats: Only signal and three closed matched controls; use paired_signal_r with paired_random_r.
MFE: Gross favorable excursion truncated at native execution path; never after stop or TP.
times: UTC and explicit Beijing entry column; exit and MFE timestamps are starts of 5-minute intervals, not exact ticks.
censored: Data boundary reached without target/stop; do not classify as profit/loss. Paired CSV keeps boundary MTM separately from resolved comparison.
selection: Choose N independently for each target/group on pre2023 meanR; evaluate2023+ excluding crossing positions. Not fresh holdout.
portfolio: Independent overlapping trades; no common funded capital/equity curve.
raw_details: signal-trades.csv.gz and all-trades.csv.gz retain prior-exit-bar bounds and all per-trade diagnostic fields.
